title: Constructible images for separated finite-type maps to Noetherian algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:Y\to Z$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. Give their point sets the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Assume $Z$ is Noetherian: it is quasi-compact, its diagonal is quasi-compact, and every etale scheme chart is locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Assume $f$ is separated and of finite type. Here separated means that its relative diagonal is representable by closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion]; finite type means quasi-compact and locally of finite type on compatible etale scheme charts, with the scheme convention [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Quasi-compactness of a morphism means that its base change by every affine scheme has quasi-compact point space. For every constructible subset $A\subseteq|Y|$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], the point image $|f|(A)$ is constructible in $|Z|$. In particular $|f|(|Y|)$ is constructible. No properness or smoothness assumption on $f$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0ECX (theorem-chevalley), combined with Tag 06G4 (lemma-noetherian-finite-type-finite-presentation) for separated finite-type maps to a locally Noetherian target; topological versus etale-local constructibility: decent-spaces.tex Tag 0ECZ (lemma-locally-constructible).

proof.text: Put $B=|f|(A)$. Fix an arbitrary representable etale map $v:V\to Z$ from an affine scheme. Form $W=Y\times_ZV$, an algebraic space by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers], with projections $a:W\to Y$ and $b:W\to V$. The definition of quasi-compactness of $f$ in the statement gives quasi-compactness of $|W|$. The map $a$ is representable etale: on every scheme test its pullback is a base change of the etale scheme projection defining $v$, as in [def-trf-algebraic-space].

source.place: Tag 0ECX (theorem-chevalley), proof: base change to an affine etale target chart

proof.text: Choose a scheme atlas of $W$ using [def-trf-algebraic-space] and refine its source by its affine open covering, taking the disjoint union of these affine opens. This is again representable etale: after every scheme test, open immersions are etale and composites of etale scheme maps are etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. The affine opens cover the old atlas, so the refinement is surjective. Apply [lem-a1-space-finite-affine-subatlas] to obtain finitely many affine schemes $U_i$ whose maps $p_i:U_i\to W$ are jointly surjective etale. Write $h_i=bp_i:U_i\to V$ and $q_i=ap_i:U_i\to Y$. Scheme testing and the same etale composition lemma show that $q_i$ is etale. Thus the compatible chart condition in the finite-type hypothesis on $f$ says that each $h_i$ is locally of finite type. The finite family may be empty if $W$ is empty.

source.place: Tag 03H6 (lemma-quasi-compact-affine-cover), finite affine chart selection; Tag 03FX (lemma-cover-by-union-affines)

proof.text: The target chart $V$ is locally Noetherian by the hypothesis on $Z$. By [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft], every $U_i$ is locally Noetherian. In fact every etale scheme chart $T\to U_i$ is locally Noetherian: its composite to $Y$ is etale by scheme testing and [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], hence the compatible map $T\to V$ is locally of finite type by the hypothesis on $f$, and [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] applies again. Each affine $U_i$ is quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs], so [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-topology], applied to $h_{U_i}$, gives Noetherianity of its atlas point space. This is the Zariski space of $U_i$: by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-field] every field-valued point $\operatorname{Spec}K\to U_i$ factors uniquely through $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to U_i$ for its image point $x$, so the map $|\mathrm{id}|:|U_i|\to|h_{U_i}|$ of [def-a1-algebraic-space-point-classes] is bijective; a subset open for the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology] is Zariski open by testing it on the identity chart, and a Zariski open has open inverse image under every etale scheme chart $T\to U_i$ since scheme morphisms are continuous. Hence the Zariski space $|U_i|$ is Noetherian. The map $|q_i|$ is continuous by [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus]. Write $A$ as a finite union of locally closed subsets using [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Their inverse images under $|q_i|$ are locally closed, because inverse images preserve opens and closed sets. In a Noetherian space this finite union is constructible by the converse clause of [def-weil-constructible-subset]. Thus $A_i=|q_i|^{-1}(A)$ is constructible in $|U_i|$.

source.place: Tag 0ECX (theorem-chevalley), inverse image on the source atlas; scheme Noetherianity: morphisms.tex Tag 01T6 (lemma-finite-type-noetherian); space topology: spaces-properties.tex Tag 04ZF (lemma-Noetherian-topology)

proof.text: Apply [pqf-lem-lft-fp-locnoeth] to $h_i:U_i\to V$ to obtain local finite presentation. Each $h_i$ is quasi-compact: a morphism between affine schemes is induced by a ring map $R\to C$, and the inverse image of a principal open $D(r)$ is the affine $\operatorname{Spec}C_r$; a quasi-compact open of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is a finite union of principal opens. The target $V$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs]. Therefore scheme Chevalley [lem-weil-pbc-chevalley-constructible-image] applies to the constructible subset $A_i$, and shows that $|h_i|(A_i)$ is constructible in $|V|$.

source.place: Tag 06G4 (lemma-noetherian-finite-type-finite-presentation), chartwise argument; Tag 0ECX (theorem-chevalley), final application of morphisms.tex Tag 054J (lemma-chevalley)

proof.text: The point lifting assertion of [lem-a1-space-point-open-calculus] gives a surjection $|W|\to|Y|\times_{|Z|}|V|$. Consequently $$|v|^{-1}(B)=\bigcup_i |h_i|(A_i).$$ Indeed the right side maps into $B$ by commutativity. Conversely if $t\in|V|$ maps to $f(y)$ for $y\in A$, lift the pair $(y,t)$ to $w\in|W|$, then lift $w$ to some $u\in|U_i|$ by joint surjectivity. This $u$ belongs to $A_i$ and maps to $t$. The union is finite and hence constructible by [def-weil-constructible-subset].

source.place: Tag 0ECX (theorem-chevalley), point-image identity using spaces-properties.tex Tag 03H4 (lemma-points-cartesian)

proof.text: We have proved that $|v|^{-1}(B)$ is constructible for every affine etale chart $v:V\to Z$. The target $Z$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by its stated Noetherian hypothesis. Apply [lem-sfb-space-constructible-affine-etale-test] to obtain constructibility of $B$ in $|Z|$. Finally $|Y|$ is constructible: it is open and retrocompact in itself, so [def-weil-constructible-subset] applies with $U=|Y|$ and $V=\varnothing$. Taking $A=|Y|$ proves the last assertion.
